observation: Both pages use a dark theme. Original: body background rgb(20,20,20), body text light grey rgb(204,204,204), panels in lighter greys rgb(34,34,34)/rgb(52,52,52)/rgb(58,58,58)/rgb(47,47,47). AI-built: body background rgb(17,17,18), near-white text rgb(242,242,242), panels rgb(27,27,29)/rgb(34,34,34), footer rgb(11,11,12).

Original uses a light sky blue rgb(119,191,255) as its main link/accent colour on 90 elements: nav items, dates, footer links and the 'Featured News' tag. AI-built uses a mid blue rgb(59,139,224) on 24 elements for text links and eyebrow labels such as '#B12HR', 'Read more →', 'Featured News →' and 'BUSHFIRES APPEAL'.

Original uses red rgb(237,28,36) as a secondary accent, limited to the active HOME nav underline and the small bars before headings. AI-built makes red rgb(228,32,46) the main accent, used on the '12 HOUR' h1 span, the primary CTA, the FEATURED badge, the Go button, the hero rule and the heading underlines (4 background uses).
Both pages have a red, blue and charcoal palette that echoes the Liqui-Moly logo colours.
Both headers carry a carbon-fibre-textured dark background with red and blue diagonal wedges sweeping in from the top right. Neither page uses CSS gradients (gradient_backgrounds 0 on both).

Original header has a large 135x156 logo at the left with a three-tier, all-caps title lockup beside it: title, lighter tagline, then a bold date line. AI-built hero puts a left-aligned text block (kicker, h1, a date block with a red left border, tagline) in an ~840px column, with a larger 260x299 logo pinned to the right.

Original h1 is 50px, weight 700, Montserrat, white, and has empty text content. AI-built h1 is 70.4px, weight 900, system sans, with the visible two-line text 'LIQUI-MOLY / BATHURST 12 HOUR'; '12 HOUR' is in a red span.

Original uses webfonts: Open Sans dominates (354 elements), with Montserrat for display, FontAwesome and Material Icons. AI-built uses a single system-font stack (-apple-system, 283 elements) with no webfonts.
Body text is 14px with a 21px line-height on the original and 16px with a 25.6px (1.6) line-height on the AI-built page.
AI-built uses a grey rgb(166,166,171) for secondary copy such as excerpts and sub-labels (61 elements). Original has no comparable mid-grey secondary text colour among its top text colours.

Original's heading outline is almost empty: an empty h1, one h4 'FOLLOW US' and two h5 tags, no h2 or h3, skipped levels, and story titles that are not headings. AI-built has a full h1 → h2 (NEWS, PLAN YOUR VISIT, SPONSORS & PARTNERS) → h3 (story titles) → h4 outline.

AI-built section h2s are uppercase bold at 28.8px, left-aligned, each with a short two-tone red/blue underline bar. Original section headings ('FOLLOW US', 'LINKS') are bold uppercase white with a short red vertical tick to the left.

Original nav is a separate inset dark bar (~1120px) below the header, with six bold blue uppercase links including BUSHFIRES APPEAL; the active item is red and underlined. AI-built nav sits inside a single 73px header bar next to the logo, with five uppercase links (no BUSHFIRES APPEAL) and a semi-transparent rgba(17,17,18,0.94) background with backdrop blur.

Original has a search icon button in a square dark-grey tile at the top right, using a Material Icons glyph. AI-built has a full search form on the right of the header, with a dark input and a red 'Go' button.

Original shows Facebook and Twitter as FontAwesome icon glyphs, in the header and in a sidebar card. AI-built shows them as plain text links 'Facebook' and 'Twitter', repeated on every news card and in the footer, with no icons. Neither page uses SVGs.

Original main content is two columns: a ~743px news column and a ~357px sidebar holding a blank box, the 'FOLLOW US' heading and a Social Media card. AI-built has no sidebar (aside 0); it is a single-column flow of full-width bands in a centred 1140px container.
Original's sidebar starts with an empty dark rectangle, probably a blank ad or widget slot (2 iframes on the page).

Original's lead story is a full-bleed 743x463 photo tile with a blue 'Featured News' chip and a white headline overlaid on the image. AI-built's featured story is a horizontal split card: a 586px image on the left and a text panel on the right with date, red FEATURED badge, h3, excerpt and link row.

Original's secondary stories are two half-width overlay tiles of unequal height (250px and 294px), then a 2-column list of horizontal cards with 195x154 thumbnails beside the title and date. AI-built's six secondary stories are a uniform 3x2 grid of vertical cards, each with a 363x227 image, date, h3 and a footer row of 'Read more →' and social links.
Original small-card titles are truncated with an ellipsis and hyphenated mid-word ('do-nation', 'perfor-mance'), and one clamped title overlaps its date line.

Original images are scaled to differing frames (195x154, 372x250, 372x294, 743x463). AI-built crops all news images to a uniform 363x227 frame. Both draw on the same sources, including the oversized 2500x1683 Bushfireappeal.jpg.
Both pages use real editorial motorsport photography (cars on track, podium, volunteers) for the news stories.
On both pages, editorial images have empty alt text while sponsor logos have descriptive alt text; alt_missing is 0 on both.
Original overlays white headlines on darkened photos in its tiles. AI-built places text below or beside images, never overlaid on them.
Original is almost entirely sharp-cornered: 362 elements at 0px radius, 2 pill-shaped, none at 1–7px. AI-built uses small radii (~4px) on 47 elements, 237 at 0px and no pills.
Original has 3 box shadows; AI-built has none and separates its cards with 1px borders and a slightly lighter surface, rgb(27,27,29).
Original has no backdrop blur. AI-built uses backdrop blur once, on its semi-transparent header bar.
Both pages use transitions, which suggests hover states. Original has 125 transitions, 2 animations and 7 transforms; AI-built has 33 transitions and no animations or transforms.
Original leaves a ~600px empty dark area between the last story row and the footer, and its sidebar ends early.

Both pages use bands of different dark tones to separate regions. Original's footer stacks a rgb(34,34,34) links band, a lighter rgb(47,47,47) sponsor band and a copyright strip. AI-built alternates rgb(17,17,18) and rgb(27,27,29) section bands with thin dividers, and has the darkest footer topped by a blue rule.

Original footer has one 'LINKS' column of four blue links (Contacts, Media, Privacy Policy, Terms & Conditions) separated by thin rules. AI-built footer has a logo and two columns: INFO with the same four links, and FOLLOW #B12HR with Facebook/Twitter and a blurb.

Original sponsor area is a 6-column grid of 100x60 logos at a 180px pitch, 32 logos in 5 rows, shown white or monochrome directly on a grey band. AI-built uses a 7-column grid of white 153x92 tiles, each holding a 100x60 logo, 26 images in 4 rows.
On the AI-built page, many white or light sponsor logos sit on white tiles and look blank, and McLaren renders as black text because its tile has no image.

Both pages end with a thin rule, a small footer logo (72x83 vs 70x80) and a '© 2021 LIQUI-MOLY Bathurst 12 Hour' copyright line. Both pair this with the 2020 event dates (31 January – 2 February 2020). AI-built adds a domain link on the right.

Copy on both pages is short and news-driven: sentence-case headline titles, no exclamation marks or em dashes, and an en dash in the event date range. Original has 129 words; AI-built has 251 and adds excerpts and tile descriptors.

Original uses an uppercase tagline 'AUSTRALIA'S INTERNATIONAL ENDURANCE RACE' in the header. AI-built adds an eyebrow tier of uppercase, wide-letter-spaced small labels ('#B12HR', 'EVENT DATES SHOWN', date stamps).

Original has a sidebar 'Social Media' card in rgb(34,34,34) with a title, the blurb 'Stay up-to-date with the latest #B12HR news via Facebook and Twitter.' and two icons. AI-built moves a short social blurb into the footer's FOLLOW #B12HR column.

Original markup is heavy: 122 divs, 8 header and 8 footer elements, 5 asides, 2 sections, 7 articles. AI-built is compact: 54 divs, 1 header, 1 footer, 4 sections, 7 articles, no asides. Both have 1 main and 1 nav.
Both pages use custom (non-utility) class names. Original has 480 class uses across 174 unique names and 10 inline styles; AI-built has 123 uses across 38 unique names and 3 inline styles.

Original loads 48 scripts and 13 stylesheets and has full OG/Twitter/robots metadata, 1 JSON-LD block and lang en-AU. AI-built has 1 script, 0 stylesheets (one inline style block), only charset/viewport/description meta, no JSON-LD and lang en.
Original lays out with floats and fixed widths: flex on 4 elements, no grid, content at x≈155–1285. AI-built uses flex on 64 elements and grid on 6, in a centred 1140px container at x150–1290.
Original title is 'Liqui-Moly Bathurst 12 Hour - Australia's International Endurance Race'; AI-built title is 'Liqui-Moly Bathurst 12 Hour | #B12HR'.
Card text hierarchy differs. Original: bold white titles with dates in regular blue. AI-built: small date, h3 title and grey excerpt, with a link footer row.

AI-built hero has two side-by-side CTAs: a solid red 'LATEST NEWS' button and an outlined 'RACE INFORMATION' ghost button. Its button style is uppercase bold with generous padding. Original has no CTA buttons; its primary button is a transparent element with red text.
AI-built has a 4x2 'Plan Your Visit' grid of 273x104 link tiles, each with a bold uppercase title, a grey descriptor and an alternating red/blue 2px top border.

AI-built has a split Bushfires Appeal banner: a 569px image and a text panel with a blue eyebrow, h3, blurb and a red 'BUSHFIRES APPEAL' button. It repeats the bushfire story's image and h3, so that heading appears twice in the outline.
On AI-built news cards, each image is wrapped in its own empty-text link that duplicates the title link inside the h3.
AI-built marks links with a trailing text arrow (→) in 'Read more →' and 'Featured News →'.
AI-built has a transparent 'Menu' toggle button with 4px radius and 8px 12px padding, presumably for mobile.
Page height is 3080px on the original and 3954px on the AI-built page, both on a 1440px-wide canvas.
